units.<strong>Estacionalidad:</strong> Diciemb: Seasonality: December €64.8K vs August €39.3K. Lever: redesign the summer offer.

units.<strong style=\"color:var(--co-green);\": Finding H3. Midday is the profitable slot (€10.67 average ticket), 35% above opening (€7.10).
Finding H1. A clear Pareto. 13 products (A) = 70% of sales · 14 products (C) = 11% → simplify the menu.
Avocado toast = anchor product. €173K revenue. It carries midday and appears in 60% of the ML combos.
units.<strong style=\"color:var(--co-green);\": Finding H2. Main combo: Kombucha + Avocado toast (lift 3.5×) → "Casa Origen Brunch" menu.
units.RevPASH global <strong>5,26 €/asiento-h<: Overall RevPASH €5.26/seat-hour, but Opening (€2.28) and Afternoon (€2.01) don’t reach the €2.50 threshold.
units.<strong style=\"color:var(--co-green);\": Finding H4 — Opening and Afternoon earn half the threshold → close at 15:30 at weekends.
units.Fin de semana: sábado y domingo mañana e: Weekends: Saturday and Sunday morning at €7.76 / €8.28 (2× the Mon–Fri average) → more staff.
units.<strong style=\"color:var(--co-green);\": Finding H3 — The ticket depends on the time slot (€7.10 → €10.67), not the day. Move afternoon spending to midday.
units.Se venden tostas y brunch (salados), los: Toasts and brunch (savoury) sell, the most expensive items on the menu.
units.<strong style=\"color:var(--co-green);\": Finding H5. Champions + Loyal (52.7%) generate 70.7% of revenue.
units.Delivery aporta 20% facturación pero com: Delivery brings in 20% of revenue, but a 30% commission leaves net margin at 43% vs 73% in-store.
